searchCriteria.targetStatement: Describe in your own words what you do, what level you want, and what you explicitly DON'T want. This plus roleFamilies is the input to `npm run db:derive-role-scope`, which generates searchCriteria.roleScope — the word lists the job-title filter uses. Example: "Backend software engineer, 6 years. Senior or Staff IC roles at infrastructure companies. Not management, not frontend, not ML research." roleFamilies above must describe the SAME job.

roleScope._note: Do not hand-write this from scratch. Generate it from targetStatement, read what it produced, then edit if needed. Search refuses to run until this is set — there is no safe default, because the built-in fallback is another candidate's operations scope in which "engineer" is a disqualifying term. Shortcut: replace this whole object with the string "ops" or "product" to use a built-in preset as-is.

applyDefaults._note: Standing answers to the questions that recur on every application. `npm run db:generate-apply-defaults` renders these into .claude/skills/apply-run/standing-answers.md (gitignored), which the apply-run skill reads. A blank field renders as "NOT SET — ask the candidate", so the apply run pauses rather than inheriting someone else's answer. Leave anything you're unsure about blank: a wrong value here is submitted to a real employer under your name.
applyDefaults._githubUrl: e.g. https://github.com/yourhandle — only asked by some engineering-adjacent forms
applyDefaults._visaStatus: e.g. "U.S. Citizen" — answers free-text "current visa status" fields
applyDefaults._securityClearanceEligible: true/false — eligible to obtain/maintain a clearance. Leave null if you don't know.
applyDefaults._ageBracket: e.g. "Under 30" — optional diversity-survey age buckets only
applyDefaults._officePreference: e.g. "San Francisco over New York" — used when a form offers a choice of office
applyDefaults._salaryAnswerStyle: e.g. "Free-text field: the posted range works. Numeric field: the median of the posted range."
applyDefaults._essayStyle: e.g. "~2 short paragraphs, at most one stacked number. Don't over-write."
applyDefaults._gpa: Only needed because some forms make it required. Leave blank otherwise.
applyDefaults._extraNotes: Anything else that recurs on forms and has a settled answer, e.g. "Has used HubSpot before, if asked."
